name: startwella-v1
description: StartWella v1 — Pricing, Startup Cost & Break-Even Toolkit for Small Businesses

scripts.dev: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const s=http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url.slice(1);let p=path.join(process.cwd(),f);if(fs.existsSync(p)){let ext=path.extname(p);let ct={'html':'text/html','js':'application/javascript','css':'text/css','json':'application/json','png':'image/png','ico':'image/x-icon'}[ext.slice(1)]||'text/plain';res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':ct});fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res);}else{res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not found');}});s.listen(3000,()=>console.log('StartWella running at http://localhost:3000'));"

author: StartWella Build Team
